meta.title: Product - Sigma CX
meta.description: We unify channels, automate processes, and transform interactions into results.

hero.title: Connecting every dot of the **customer journey**
hero.lead: We unify channels, automate processes, and transform interactions into results. With SigmaCX, every point of the customer journey gains consistency, intelligence, and fluidity.

cases.title: Solutions we build together
cases.fractaliaLead: Sigma Insights modernizes service operations by offering greater **stability, efficiency and centralization**, resulting in higher productivity, better quality perception and more satisfied customers, while also paving the way for evolution with artificial intelligence.

fractaliaResults.title: Reduction of complaints
fractaliaResults.body: 20% reduction in complaints related to call quality and disconnections, thanks to greater platform stability.

fractaliaResults.title: Improved perception of quality
fractaliaResults.body: Customer satisfaction grew, reaching 87% positive perception and reflecting a 3 percentage point improvement in perceived quality

fractaliaResults.title: Increased productivity
fractaliaResults.body: Expansion of digital channels without a proportional increase in human resources generated +15% in team productivity.

fractaliaResults.title: Efficient multilingual service
fractaliaResults.body: Automatic translation in text channels allowed us to serve in multiple languages without the need to hire additional agents, resulting in +10% productivity.

cases.fractaliaQuote: When quality and technology meet, amazing results are born.
cases.tecbanLead: Sigma Insights has transformed call management with automated analytics, bringing operational efficiency and a significant increase in customer satisfaction.

tecbanResults.title: Evolution of positive customer sentiment
tecbanResults.body: Satisfaction grew from just 4% in 2023 to 46% in 2025, a more than 1,000% increase in positive sentiment, while neutral interactions fell from 90% to 22%.

tecbanResults.title: Reducing silences in calls
tecbanResults.body: The percentage of silence dropped from 29% to 25%, making interactions more objective and fluid.

tecbanResults.title: Greater operational efficiency
tecbanResults.body: Adjustments identified by the analyses reduced, for example, 23 seconds in the TMO in specific service flows.

tecbanResults.title: Fewer callbacks
tecbanResults.body: Changes to customer service scripts reduced the volume of repeat contacts, improving the customer experience and clarity.

cases.tecbanQuote: When listening to the customer turns into business results.

brain.title: Sigma Brain responding, adjusting and solving for you.
brain.body: It's not a standalone product, but rather part of the SigmaCX ecosystem. It's the platform's intelligent engine: it operates across all channels, executing actions to resolve end-to-end demands, combining context, automation and personalization.

channel.title: All your connections made easier in *Sigma Channel*
channel.body: Centralize all service channels on a single platform and have a complete and integrated view of interactions.

intelligence.title: We transform every interaction into **strategic intelligence**
intelligence.lead: With SigmaCX, your conversations are no longer just records; they become input for improving customer service:

items.title: From conversation to insight
items.body: We transcribe and analyze interactions in real time, applying sentiment analysis, automatic categorization, and trend identification.

items.title: Data that generates action
items.body: Intuitive dashboards and strategic reports that reveal bottlenecks, anticipate problems, and guide operational changes.

items.title: Continuous efficiency
items.body: By automating workflows and reducing manual tasks, we increase team productivity and customer satisfaction.

intelligence.quote: Companies that use **analytics** achieve up to **23% higher revenue growth and 12% higher customer retention.**
